source_catalog.title: Chimaeron Strategy Guide - Blackwing Descent Raid Cataclysm Classic
source_catalog.author: Beanna
source_catalog.notes: Re-read 2026-09-25 (page 'Updated: 2024/06/04'). Spread at least 6 yd while Pip's/Finkle's Mixture is up; collapse behind the boss within 6 yd during Systems Failure; heal everyone above 10,000; Double Attack roughly every 10 s needs a taunt swap; Break roughly every 15-20 s; Massacre roughly every 30 s; Systems Failure 26 s; Feud 30 s; Mortality at 20%: +10% damage taken, -99% healing, taunt immune; pause DPS at 25-22%, wait for Massacre, Bloodlust, then push; health 25.9M/36.2M/90.6M/126.8M; ability table Caustic Slime 270480.

source_catalog.notes: Re-read 2026-09-25. source_catalog.title: BigWigs_Cataclysm Blackwing/Chimaeron.lua
source_catalog.notes: OnEngage: Berserk 450, Break CD 4.8, Caustic Slime 15, Massacre 25. Pip's Mixture cast success -> 30 s warmup bar. Systems Failure applied -> 25 s bar (normal: stop Break bar). Break applied -> CD 14.2. Massacre start -> 4 s cast bar, Break CD 13.6. Massacre success -> next Massacre 25, Caustic Slime 15. Mortality (82890 cast success) -> stage 2. Phase-2 warning below 24%.

source_catalog.title: DBM-Cataclysm DBM-Raids-Cata/BlackwingDescent/Chimaeron.lua
source_catalog.notes: Combat start: Massacre 26, Break CD 4.5, Berserk 450 (commented --Heroic). Break next 15 ('Also double attack CD'). Massacre cast 4, next Massacre 30, Caustic Slime 'always 19 seconds after massacre', Break CD 14 after Massacre start. Systems Failure active 26; comment: 'bot goes offline after massacre 2~3 cast ... 3rd massacre cast 100%'. Health info frame threshold 10000. Phase-2 prewarning 22-25%.

lifecycle.repository: Finkle gossip activates Bile-O-Tron; wake sequence; encounter frame/world state; phase-one events; heroic summons Nefarius. Engage resets the killed-player counter (Full of Sound and Fury world state).

Disengage, remove boss auras, despawn Bile-O-Tron/Finkle after 30s delay, despawn heroic Nefarius, despawn boss at evade. Since 2026-09-25 Reset() also restores knockout chance 40, killed-player count 0, Feud false and clears the Mortality taunt immunity (a compatibility-mode respawn keeps the AI object).
BossAI DONE path; aura/frame cleanup; Bile shutdown +6s; Finkle talk +6s; heroic Nefarius defeat action; instance DONE generic Nefarius notification.

unresolved.evidence_gap: Cutoff identity is frozen (4.4.2 build 59185); no 4.4.2 source supplies Chimaeron tuning. The 4.4.2 client rows for the chain are not extracted yet (4.3.4 execution-client rows are recorded).
Break exclusion now follows the official 4.0.6 hotfix text; normal/heroic versus 10/25 target-count mapping still conflicts for 25N/10H and no WCL target observation is pinned.

Reroute 26000 ms resolved from client rows. Knockout probability conflicts: native 40/60/80/100%, DBM 'after massacre 2~3 cast ... 3rd 100%'. Needs Systems Failure versus Massacre counts from several WCL kills.

Massacre 26/30 s and Break 15 s agree with DBM. Open: first Caustic Slime after engage (native 5 s, BigWigs 15 s), Break/Double Attack after Massacre (native 11 s, addons 13.6-14 s), wake-up (native 23 s, BigWigs 30 s). Needs WCL cast/aura timelines.

4.3.4 execution-client rows resolve damage, radius, durations, stacks and the mixture threshold. The 4.4.2 reference rows (extract_442_client_spell_rows --follow-triggers) are not extracted in this pass.
Heroic only (out of the 10N scope): delay from Systems Failure and Feud removal still need an observation.
Normal health conflicts (native 20.70M/72.49M vs guide 25.9M/90.6M; heroic agrees). Boss melee DamageModifier is uncalibrated (upstream value 1) pending WCL U samples.
Reset() now reinitializes knockout chance, killed-player count, Feud state and taunt immunity; a controlled wipe/reset observation is still needed.
Repository DONE/FAIL and encounter 1023 do not establish retail lockout, loot, achievement or reset persistence.
